mentions.note: 5th, London Transport 7 mile road walking championship

photos.c: The winning team (District Line) in the London Transport 7 mile road walking championship has a more than slightly familiar look. From left to right: Ron Day was 3rd, John Dunsford was 2nd in 59:32 and Jonathon Dunsford completed the team with 5th place.
